block.turnkey_factory.controller.tooltip: Builds a factory shell — walls, roof, windows, doors — from a ghost preview.
Set the size and style, then press Build in its interface.
block.turnkey_factory.leveler.tooltip.su: Flattens the terrain around itself to a target height (cut and fill).
block.turnkey_factory.leveler.tooltip.re: Place a shovel (and a pickaxe for stone) inside, then press Start.
Pulls fill material from linked inventories.
block.turnkey_factory.texturizer.tooltip: Re-textures natural ground around itself in a stone or dirt mosaic.
Place a pickaxe (stone) or shovel (dirt) inside, then press Start.
Pulls cobblestone or dirt from linked inventories.
block.turnkey_factory.lamplighter.toolti: Plants lampposts around itself on a spaced grid to light the area.
Press Start in its interface — no tool needed.
Pulls torches, iron ingots and logs from linked inventories.
block.turnkey_factory.starter_house.tool: One-click starter house — stamps a furnished cabin around itself.
Open its interface and press Build — instant, the block is consumed.
Overwrites the outline; the door faces the way you placed it.
block.turnkey_factory.wooden_frame.toolt: Crafting component for the Starter House Kit.
block.turnkey_factory.turret_base.toolti: Coal-powered turret base — burns furnace fuel to power a weapon.
Needs a redstone signal to fire — no On/Off button in its interface.
Burns furnace fuel (coal, charcoal, blaze rods…) from linked inventories.
block.turnkey_factory.turret_base_create: Kinetic turret base — draws power from a Create network to fire a weapon.
Connect a shaft from below, or a Cogwheel on the side.
Needs a weapon, enough speed, ammo, and a redstone signal to fire.
Turret weapon — mount on a base for automatic hitscan fire.
Fires iron or copper nuggets, or manufactured slugs for double damage.
block.turnkey_factory.turret_flamethrowe: Turret weapon — mount on a base to spray burning, slowing flames.
Runs on lava — pour a bucket on the base or pipe it in (%s buckets, %s mB/shot).
Breaking the base empties its tank — drain it before moving the turret.
block.turnkey_factory.turret_weapon.tool: Must be placed on a turret base
item.turnkey_factory.architect_blueprint: Crafting component for the Factory Controller.
item.turnkey_factory.control_core.toolti: Crafting component for the Factory Controller.
item.turnkey_factory.copper_nugget.toolt: Turret ammo — half the damage of an iron nugget.
item.turnkey_factory.ammo_slug.tooltip: Manufactured turret ammo — double the damage of an iron nugget.
item.turnkey_factory.ammo_incendiary.too: Manufactured turret ammo — double damage, and ignites the target for 5 seconds.
item.turnkey_factory.incendiary_charge.t: Applied to an Armor-Piercing Slug to make it an Incendiary Slug (8 charges).
item.turnkey_factory.incomplete_ammo_slu: Transient item — carries a slug through Create's belt assembly line.
gui.turnkey_factory.machine.set_center.t: Makes this block the shared reference point for adjacent leveler/texturizer/lamplighter machines (their work area recenters on it).
gui.turnkey_factory.controller.force.too: Builds anyway and replaces the blocks flagged in red with the intended factory block.
gui.turnkey_factory.controller.ignore.to: Builds around the blocks flagged in red: they stay as they are, no extra material needed.
gui.turnkey_factory.leveler.status.missi: Paused: no fill material in linked inventories
gui.turnkey_factory.texturizer.coarse_di: Adds a bit of vegetation on coarse dirt
gui.turnkey_factory.texturizer.info.dirt: Dirt/podzol/rooted dirt (33%% each) — %s cells, %s dirt available
gui.turnkey_factory.texturizer.status.mi: Paused: needs cobblestone in linked inventories
Paused: needs dirt in linked inventories
gui.turnkey_factory.lamplighter.material: %s lamps planned — 1 torch, 1 ingot and 1 log each
gui.turnkey_factory.lamplighter.status.m: Paused: needs torches/iron ingots/logs in linked inventories
gui.turnkey_factory.lamplighter.status.n: Paused: no logs in linked inventories
gui.turnkey_factory.turret.status.no_wea: No weapon — place one on top of the base
gui.turnkey_factory.starter_house.conten: A furnished cabin: bed, chests and barrels, furnace and smoker, crafting table and lanterns. The door faces the way you placed the block.
gui.turnkey_factory.starter_house.warnin: Instant and final: everything inside the outline is overwritten, and this block is consumed.
